title: Warm Peppery Norwegian Sea Bass Bake
description: A light and flavorful Norwegian dish featuring sea bass with a crunchy peppery crust
instructions: Rinse the sea bass fillets under cold water, pat dry with paper towels.
Season the fillets with flaky sea salt and freshly cracked black peppercorns.
In a small saucepan, melt the butter over low heat.
Add the chopped parsley to the melted butter and stir to combine.
Place the sea bass fillets on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the parsley butter mixture evenly over the top of each fillet.
Dot the top of each fillet with a tablespoon of olive oil.
Bake the sea bass in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes or until cooked through.
Serve the sea bass hot with a squeeze of lemon and additional parsley if desired.
